column5: Bryxle *very simple lego/minecraft building world (if you like to build things)
Butter of Terror *Horror but not too scary game
Embrace Your Fears - Nyctophobia *Horror game that was pretty fun to figure out
Halloween Visitor *Horror game (if i remember right i got too scared to finish this & its only 1 player)
Horror Portal Hub *If you like horror this has a great collection of both quest and PC horror worlds so you should look there for more
Lonely Yard In The Rain *Horror/Puzzle world
Open The Door *fun little puzzle solving world (takes like an hour)
Power Stars 2! *A 2nd fully playable level from Mario 64 (if you played the original try these)
Power Stars! *You can play entire level from Mario64 including collecting yellow& red coins & stars
Star-Gatherers *Cute little star fishing game (very first world I ever visited)
Thief Wars (Udon) *Fairly basic but fun competition game
Treasure Hunt Island *Fun treasure hunt game
Väsen *Spooky game (I cant actually say this is good because I never tried it, I went to the world, got too spooked and left vowing to return with someone else so I didnt have to do it alone)

ほらーはうす *I believe this is the 1st of several horror worlds with this one being the easiest and most basic (I have not tried the others but if I remember right this one was fun, and you had to find keys)
